remarks: Experience comfort and convenience in this beautifully designed corner unit in the heart of Springdale. Filled with natural light, the open layout features a modern kitchen with sleek finishes that flows seamlessly into the dining area and a spacious living room-perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Truly one-of-a-kind, this unit is the only home in the community to feature both a private patio and a separate deck, providing a unique blend of indoor and outdoor living. The large primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with generous closet space and a spa like full bathroom. Enjoy the ease of a private in-unit elevator, attached one-car garage, and access to a tranquil walking path by the river. Community amenities include an in-ground pool and fitness center, all just minutes from the train, restaurants, and shops.
